_comment: Optional Versions panel. Copy to ~/.config/server-monitor/versions.json and list the tools you want the menu to report. The app's OWN version + build is always shown from its bundle and needs no entry here. Each component argv executes directly with a deadline (NO shell interpolation) and the FIRST non-empty stdout line is shown as its version; a nonzero exit, timeout, or empty output shows as 'unavailable' in red. Commands run LAZILY (first expand and Refresh), never on a status poll. 'enabled': false skips a component. Keep real tool names and host paths in the untracked copy.
